texts: mixed: everything is there and nothing is distorted — the Council, the beginning, the new ledger and the yearly recurrence all appear — but "every year" is recorded as a flat frequency tag on a single beginning of a single ledger, so "a new ledger each year" collapses onto one ledger witness and no per-year rule is produced. Nothing in the parse lets a reader ask which ledger a given year got, or derive one ledger per year. If you want the annual cycle to actually generate a ledger per occasion, use the occurrence wording, which our translator turns into a firing rule: "Whenever a new year begins, the Council begins a new ledger."
